results.prop: C4 operating domain (FormationRule.check_clock_speed raises outside it): every admitted clock speed leaves the catch-up margin v_catch_min = 0.1 in the keeping and the recovery modes, the caps within the vehicle authority v_max_nominal = 0.5, and v_catch_min > w_res + s_res
results.formula: v_plan + v_catch_min <= v_rec -> keeping_cap - v_plan >= v_catch_min, v_rec - v_plan >= v_catch_min, keeping_cap <= v_rec <= v_max_nominal, v_catch_min > w_res + s_res
results.note: keeping_cap = min(v_recovery_max, max(v_slot_max, v_plan + v_catch_min)), the code of Flows.formation

results.prop: C4m mutation (constant keeping cap): the constant keeping cap v_slot_max leaves no margin at an admitted clock (integrated_short 0.40 m/s)
results.formula: exists v_plan in the domain: v_slot_max - v_plan < v_catch_min

results.prop: C3e one reduced-progress episode adds at most d_max t_rejoin + v d_max^2 / (2 a_wait) = 10.83 s to tau (v_plan 0.30: 3.25 m of reference offset)
results.formula: inductive invariant: running: tau <= d_max E;  ended: tau + v d^2 / (2 a) <= d_max E + v d_max^2 / (2 a)
results.note: control/formation_time.py: rate ramps at a_wait / v_plan, d = 1 - rate, E the moving time of the episode (<= t_rejoin); same-lane following and the sync follow another drone's tau

results.prop: C3h rendezvous hold (FormationTime._hold_resync): inside a planned hold tau' = max(0, t - end) keeps the slot still, never raises tau, contracts the difference of two drones and zeroes it when both are within the dwell
results.formula: in hold -> 0 <= tau' <= tau, t - tau' in hold, |tau_i' - tau_j'| <= |tau_i - tau_j|, (t <= end -> tau_i' = tau_j' = 0)

results.prop: C3m mutation (no re-synchronisation in the hold): without the hold re-synchronisation two drones leave the rendezvous with the delay difference they brought
results.formula: exists tau_i != tau_j in the hold: tau' = tau

results.prop: C2a clock consensus, nominal clock (v_plan 0.30): max(0, X - B - delta) + (rho_d - rho_i)^+ decreases by >= 0.00040 m per step while X > B + delta (B = band_max + eta = 1.50 m, delta = 0.05), sigma by consensus or frozen
results.formula: X > B + delta -> X' <= B + delta or R' <= R - eps
results.note: rate 0.0040 m/s (k_progress delta at most, after the rate ramp); the drone behind keeps its speed (C2j); eventual agreement |X| <= B + delta, by the symmetry i <-> j

results.prop: C2b ultimate band, nominal clock: |X| <= B + 2 delta = 1.60 m is invariant (sigma by consensus or frozen)
results.formula: -(B + 2 delta) <= X <= B + 2 delta -> X' within the same band
results.note: one step moves X by less than delta; above B + delta it decreases (C2a)

results.prop: C2c lock exclusion, nominal clock: an abreast pair 3.5 m apart within the band has a range residual below e_ok (B + 2 delta = 1.60 m < sqrt((L + e_ok)^2 - L^2) = 1.94 m)
results.formula: X^2 <= (B + 2 delta)^2 -> sqrt(L^2 + X^2) - L < e_ok
results.note: the guard self_recovered is then reachable (with C1n)

results.prop: C2j the drone behind sees no lag in the region X >= 0: it does not slow down (its rate ramps back to 1 at a_wait), so only the drone ahead re-synchronises
results.formula: X >= 0 -> -X - n_j - band_j <= 0

results.prop: C2l declared limit: the ranking of C2a is not a ranking when sigma only leaks (leak-only: an abreast B2 pair beyond the presence gate, its sonar residual without along part): the leak can push X up faster than the re-synchronisation pulls it down; a common ranking across the sigma regimes is open
results.formula: exists a leak step with X > B + delta, R' > R - eps
results.note: X + |sigma_i| + |sigma_j| is non-increasing in the leak / frozen regime (C2d); the closed loop with the switching converges offline (tests/test_p3_recovery_fixes.py), not proved

results.prop: C2d leak / frozen regime: X + |sigma_i| + |sigma_j| never increases, and decreases by dt v rho_i'
results.formula: Phi' <= Phi - dt v rho_i'

results.prop: C2m mutation (no re-synchronisation in FORMATION_RECOVERY, the defect): without the re-synchronisation in FORMATION_RECOVERY a pair of drones both recovering, sigma relaxed, X >= 1.94 m stays there (the residual of the abreast pair stays above e_ok: FORMATION_RECOVERY for ever)
results.formula: exists a state of the lock set whose successor is in it with X' = X
results.note: the set {rho_i = 0, sigma = 0, X >= 1.94 m} is closed under the step without the re-synchronisation; offline: delays of 8 s and more

results.prop: C2w pair clock gap with a missing report outside the lag band
results.formula: X > B + delta -> D' <= D - decrement, D = X - sigma_i + sigma_j
results.note: fixed ahead/behind role in the pair model; repeated usable reports force entrance into the lag band because D stays bounded below while X stays outside it. This does not prove the switched in-band dynamics.
